race.description: Doyalson Wyee Rsl Sub Branch Mdn Plate
race.comment: MADE IN ITALY (10) has the right profile to break through after a sound fifth in a Warwick Farm Maiden, where she began awkwardly, was blocked early and was still only beaten just over two lengths. Her Newcastle second two runs back reads well, and her record around 1600m gives her the most reliable exposed base. KOIBITO (9) is the main danger if she rebounds from a Warwick Farm seventh, with the easier meeting, third-up timing and weight relief all in her favour. MARCH (11) has upside after a close up debut third at a big price at Illawarra Grange, beaten a neck, though 1600m is new territory. Schiller sticks and not to be underestimated. MARKOS PORT (4) jumped in grade with a narrow third over 1600m at Warwick Farm in a Super Maiden. Leading rider booked and place preferred from the draw.
